<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Gemma 4 multimodal models currently build their vision and audio components and load their weights even for text-only serving. This increases memory usage and model load time. It also causes SGLang to treat the model as multimodal and disable the prefill CUDA graph because breakable CUDA graphs are incompatible with multimodal models.

This PR makes Gemma 4 multimodal loading opt-in with `--enable-multimodal`, matching Llama 4 and Gemma 3.

> On a DGX Spark with TP1, text-only mode increased the default static memory fraction from `0.8115` to `0.8880` and reduced memory used by model weights. Together, these changes increased the KV cache capacity from 265,062 to 326,684 tokens, an increase of 61,622 tokens or 23.2%.

## Modifications

- Default `gemma4_mm` and `gemma4_unified` to text-only mode.
- Build and load vision and audio components only when `--enable-multimodal` is set.
- Update Gemma 4 deployment documentation with the new default and flag.
- Enable multimodal mode explicitly in the existing Gemma 4 MMMU eval configurations.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This PR does not change model computation. 
The registered Gemma 4 MMMU eval configurations now pass `--enable-multimodal` explicitly and keep their existing thresholds.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This PR only skips multimodal component construction and weight loading during text-only serving. The inference path is unchanged when multimodal mode is enabled.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://
  docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

nodes.body:
Replaced `get_server_args().enable_multimodal` with `get_mm().enable_multimodal`, the accessor mllama4 and inkling also moved to in #33013.

The vision/audio checkpoint name fragments are now a class attribute and moved the skip to `_should_skip_multimodal_weight()`, mirroring mllama4's `_should_skip_weight()`. Fragments cover every published Gemma 4 checkpoint: E2B / E4B carry vision + audio, 26B-A4B / 31B vision only, and the encoder-free 12B carries vision + audio under its own module names.

12B is the only size on the unified architecture, which overrides the tuple with its own names in `gemma4_unified.py`. End-to-end 12B serving is separately broken on a regression from #22498 as `lm_head_is_tied` is unset on the unified class. Fix is up as #35809.

@@ -105,6 +105,7 @@ The Gemma 4 series offers models in various sizes and architectures, optimized f
 
 ### 3.2 Configuration Tips
 
+- **Multimodal loading is opt-in**: Gemma 4 starts in text-only mode and does not load the vision or audio modules. Add `--enable-multimodal` to accept image, video, or audio inputs.
 - SGLang automatically selects the Triton attention backend for Gemma 4 models (required for bidirectional image-token attention during prefill).
 - **Attention backend on Blackwell (B200/sm100)**: SGLang defaults to the `trtllm_mha` backend on sm100, which is fastest for text but applies *causal* attention to image tokens. For multimodal (image) workloads on B200, pass `--attention-backend triton` to restore bidirectional image-token attention and full vision quality. Text-only and audio workloads are unaffected by the default.
 - **Attention backend on Intel XPU (BMG)**: for the 12B, 26B-A4B and 31B models (`use_bidirectional_attention: "vision"`), `--attention-backend intel_xpu` gives image tokens bidirectional attention within each image on the sliding-window layers, while full-attention layers stay causal, as in Hugging Face; E2B and E4B keep image tokens causal. The sgl-kernel-xpu mask has no sliding-window variant, so it applies only while the longest sequence in the prefill batch, counting its cached prefix, fits in the 1024-token window; otherwise image tokens fall back to causal attention for the whole batch. A short image request batched with a long prompt, or sent after a long chat history, loses it too. For document and OCR workloads, `--mm-process-config '{"image":{"max_soft_tokens":560}}'` keeps a single image with a short prompt inside the window; 1120 does not.

inline_comments.body:
Replaced `get_server_args().enable_multimodal` with `get_mm().enable_multimodal`, the accessor mllama4 and inkling also moved to in #33013.

The vision/audio checkpoint name fragments are now a class attribute and moved the skip to `_should_skip_multimodal_weight()`, mirroring mllama4's `_should_skip_weight()`. Fragments cover every published Gemma 4 checkpoint: E2B / E4B carry vision + audio, 26B-A4B / 31B vision only, and the encoder-free 12B carries vision + audio under its own module names.

12B is the only size on the unified architecture, which overrides the tuple with its own names in `gemma4_unified.py`. End-to-end 12B serving is separately broken on a regression from #22498 as `lm_head_is_tied` is unset on the unified class. Fix is up as #35809.
